input.text: Hi Sarah! I don't have access to your sales pipeline data or CRM, so I can't pull that number for you. If you let me know which tool or data source has the pipeline info (e.g., the CRM dashboard, a report, or an API), I can help you work with it from there.

content.text: Replied to Sarah. I don't have any tools wired up to query your sales pipeline/CRM data, so I let her know and asked where that data lives so I can help next.
